title: Prelookup
text: Compute index and fraction for Interpolation Using Prelookup block, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Name} sets Name of a; {Specification} sets how to enter breakpoint data Explicit, {Source} sets the source of breakpoint, {Value} sets the breakpoint data values, {First point}, {Spacing}, {Number of points} sets the number of evenly spaced points, {Output selection} sets the signals the block outputs Index, {Index search method} sets the method for searching breakpoint data Binary, {Begin index search using previous index result} sets the start search using the index found at the previous time, {Extrapolation method} sets the method for handling out-of-range input values, {Use last breakpoint for input at or above upper limit} sets the method of handling inputs at or above upper, {Assume input is within range} sets the option to check for out-of-range input, {Diagnostic for out-of-range input} sets the block action when input is out of range, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Breakpoint}, {Index}, {Fraction}, {Output}, {Breakpoint Minimum} sets the minimum value breakpoint data can have, {Breakpoint Maximum} sets the maximum value breakpoint data can have, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Input signal, u scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: bp

ports.summary: Index of the interval containing the input, u scalar | vector | matrix
